# Introduction

This book documents my Emacs environment, and the concepts I have learned along the way while building it.

The configuration is maintained in Org mode as it serves two purposes:

- Working configuration for my Emacs setup.
- A learning document to cover elisp and emacs concepts plus useful commands.


# Org File

The material is being moved gradually from the original Org file into this book.

- **elisp notes** — Emacs and Emacs Lisp concepts needed just enough to understand the configuration.

- **Configuration** — Nuts and bolts of package management, appearance, completion, language tooling, programming modes and other settings.

::: {.callout-important}
The original `config.org` remains the working source. This book is its published reference.
:::


## Prerequisites

The following external tools and language servers are listed in my Org configuration as prerequisites for this setup:

| Tool | Purpose / installation note in the Org file |
|---|---|
| ripgrep | Fast text search utility; installed with `brew` |
| LLVM toolchain | Rust debugging; `brew install llvm` |
| Rust Analyzer | `rustup component add rust-analyzer` |
| rust-script | Execute Rust scripts in Org; `cargo install rust-script` |
| Pyright | Python language server; `pip install pyright` |
| Bash language server | `npm install -g bash-language-server` |
